# Evidence map

Every fake-adb fixture row the v0.1 test suite must cover, with the scenario file that replays it and the tests that assert on it.
Scenario files live in `scenarios/`; their format is defined in `../fake-adb/scenario.ts`.
Captured real-device output goes under `captured/<api>/`; output written from sources instead of a device is marked `"synthetic": true` in its scenario, with a `source`.

A row is complete when it names a scenario and at least one test. The integration slice checks that every row is complete.

| Evidence     | Behaviour replayed                                     | Scenario                               | Tests                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| H1-H4, S3    | adb waits forever on a missing or offline device       | pending (F2)                           | pending                                                                                                                                                                              |
| H5           | a device flag before the command                       | `scenarios/misplaced-device-flag.json` | `test/cli/bin.test.ts` "rejects `-s <serial>` before the command ..." and "rejects the same misplaced flag in JSON ..."; `test/unit/cli.test.ts` "rejects a leading device flag ..." |
| H6           | `emu avd name` prints nothing and exits 1              | pending (F2)                           | pending                                                                                                                                                                              |
| H7-H9        | one failure, several error shapes and exit codes       | pending (F2)                           | pending                                                                                                                                                                              |
| S1           | `exec-out` exits 0 with error text as the bytes        | pending (E)                            | pending                                                                                                                                                                              |
| S2           | legacy shell exits 0 whatever the remote exit          | pending (P1)                           | pending                                                                                                                                                                              |
